In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy. With value 7, bidding 7 maximizes expected profit: underbidding risks losing when the second-highest bid is below 7, and overbidding risks winning and paying above your value, yielding negative profit. No history is available, so no adjustment for opponent behavior is possible. Therefore, bid exactly 7 (in 0.1 increments).
